content.short: Chime is a leading US consumer neobank with fee-free checking, savings, a debit card and credit building.
content.description: Chime, founded in 2013, is one of the largest consumer neobanks in the United States, serving millions of members through its mobile app rather than branches. Working with partner banks, it offers fee-free checking and high-yield savings accounts, a debit card, secured credit-builder cards, early direct deposit, automatic savings and fee-free overdraft through its SpotMe feature. Chime is built for everyday Americans underserved by traditional banks and earns most of its money from card interchange rather than monthly fees or overdraft charges. Its focus on simple, low-cost accounts at large scale made it a defining example of the US consumer neobank.
